project.name: sas-jdbc-wrapper
project.description: JDBC driver wrapper for SAS (IOM / SAS 9.4 Integration Technologies JDBC driver) used with Starburst's Generic JDBC connector. Starts as a transparent call tracer (every JDBC call logged, delegate untouched) to diagnose schema/catalog discovery issues, with an extension point to grow into a behavioral wrapper (e.g. remapping getSchemas()/getCatalogs()) once a specific fix is validated against a real SAS IOM environment.
